summary: Braemar Hotels & Resorts Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its sale of the Park Hyatt Beaver Creek Resort & Spa in Avon, Colorado, for $176 million in cash. The seller was the registrant's indirect subsidiaries, Ashford BC LP and Ashford TRS BC LLC. The buyer was Apres Owner, LLC. The company used part of the proceeds to repay a $70.5 million mortgage loan on the hotel, retaining ~$104.5 million net after transaction costs. Separately, it used proceeds to repay $86.25 million of its 4.50% Convertible Senior Notes due 2026 at maturity. No board recommendation, advisors, or premium were disclosed. Watch for future capital allocation plans and potential reinvestment or shareholder returns given the retained cash.
